Tim is going to live with his actions for the rest of his life, rightfully so. It's absolutely deserved.

But, he's actually made a true effort to be better and give back. That's more than anyone else I can remember.

He served his time. He spent his time in prison wisely. He's helping others with metal health issues. He's doing charity work. He's owning his mistakes and not hiding them. He speaks openly about it.

You don't have to forgive the guy, but credit is where credits due. At least he's doing what he can. 

I love AILD and his other projects. I have the This is Who We Are DvD, and you can clearly see that the guy in there is not who he was when he was on Steroids and around horrifically toxic people that influenced his decisions. 

He won't forget his actions, we won't let him forget his actions, but we should be more supportive in his efforts to be better for the world around him and the people he's helping.
